in_marathi.name: Bimay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bimay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bimay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhima’ which means ‘strong’ and ‘Bima’ meaning ‘god’s grace’. This name is associated with strength, courage, and protection from the divine.
